name: India–Pakistan
summary: India–Pakistan tension after October border killings; no military strikes
state: Indian border guards shot dead two people on the Punjab border on 2 Oct and both countries summoned diplomats. No cross-border military strikes have occurred since the 2025 clashes, and no new Line of Control incident had been reported as of 3 Nov; Pakistan's military focus is on its Afghan border.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for border areas of India and Pakistan.

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Pakistan summons Indian diplomat over border killing

why: Two nuclear-armed neighbours with a history of rapid escalation after terrorist attacks.
drivers: Kashmir attacks, Line of Control firing, water disputes (Indus), domestic politics.

rubric.watch: Ceasefire violations, a major terrorist attack with blame assigned, or treaty suspensions.
rubric.normal: Ceasefire holding along the Line of Control; no major attacks.
